donors.reason: DOT1L histone methyltransferase inhibitor; directly perturbs H3K79 methylation, supporting epigenetic transfer to H3K27 mark changes.
BET bromodomain inhibitor altering chromatin reader function; plausible donor for histone acetylation/methylation perturbation.
DNA synthesis inhibitor causing DNA damage; can indirectly alter histone modification landscapes, matching observed H3K27 changes.

revised_hypotheses: LY-294002 at 10 uM for 24 h in A375 induces reproducible histone mark changes, particularly decreased H3K27me1K36me1 and H3K27me0K36me2, consistent with PI3K inhibition affecting chromatin modifiers.
Donors with direct epigenetic pharmacology (EPZ-5676, GSK525762A) are more likely to transfer relevant histone perturbation responses than non-epigenetic donors.
Etoposide may serve as a DNA-damage-linked donor whose downstream histone changes partially overlap with LY-294002 effects.
unresolved: No direct histone modification data for LY-294002 in A375; donor transfer remains inferential.
Resveratrol source retrieval returned no pharmacology description, so its epigenetic mechanism is unsupported.
Whether the observed H3K27 mark changes are reproducible (>0.5 log2 vs vehicle) in independent assays is unknown.
